overview.description: The Bitwise Avalanche ETF (BAVA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long avax, short usd currency. The fund is a passively managed ETP that offers 100% direct exposure to Avalanche (AVAX) while seeking to earn additional AVAX from staking rewards. BAVA was launched on Apr 14, 2026 and is issued by Bitwise.
